name: web3-repo-risk-review-agent-gitlab-tools
description: Planned GitLab MCP tool usage for the Web3 Repo Risk Review Agent.

tools.name: summarize_merge_request
tools.purpose: Read merge request metadata, changed files, labels, discussion, and pipeline status.

tools.name: create_review_comment
tools.purpose: Post a concise Web3 risk review comment on the merge request.

tools.name: label_merge_request
tools.purpose: Apply risk labels such as risk:block-release or risk:changes-requested.

tools.name: open_issue
tools.purpose: Open a release-blocking issue when critical contract, payment, or CI risk is detected.
